# Browser download callback function<AvailableFrom v="4.0.137" />

Gets called when no compatible local browser is detected on the system and this API needs to download a browser. Return a callback to observe progress. [See here for how to use this option.](/docs/renderer/ensure-browser#onbrowserdownload)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`ensureBrowser()`](/docs/renderer/ensure-browser#onbrowserdownload)
- [`getCompositions()`](/docs/renderer/get-compositions#onbrowserdownload)
- [`openBrowser()`](/docs/renderer/open-browser#onbrowserdownload)
- [`renderFrames()`](/docs/renderer/render-frames#onbrowserdownload)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#onbrowserdownload)
- [`renderStill()`](/docs/renderer/render-still#onbrowserdownload)
- [`selectComposition()`](/docs/renderer/select-composition#onbrowserdownload)
